England equalized before halftime through an attacking play.
Jude Bellingham received a yellow card during the match.
England secured their lead in the second half with a decisive goal.

matches.tactical_summary: England faced a resilient DR Congo side that employed a strong defensive setup, initially taking the lead. England had to work hard to break down their opponents, eventually finding their rhythm to secure a comeback victory.

narrative: England narrowly avoided a Round of 32 upset, coming from behind to defeat a spirited DR Congo side 2-1 in Atlanta. The victory ensures England's progression to the Quarterfinals, but not without a significant challenge from the African team.
next_round_notes: England will need to manage squad depth, as John Stones was noted to have missed this match due to yellow card accumulation, which could impact future defensive options.
